accessibility_need.description: Something the caller needs the agent to accommodate

appointment_time.description: When the caller's next appointment is

callback_number.description: Number to call the caller back on

calling_on_behalf_of.description: Person the caller is calling for

consent_to_record.description: Whether the caller agreed to the call being recorded

name.description: Name the caller wants to be called

note.description: A statement worth keeping that no other predicate fits, in the words it was stated

open_request.description: Something the caller asked for that is not done yet

preferred_contact_time.description: When the caller wants to be called

preferred_language.description: Language the caller wants to speak

prefers_response_style.description: How the caller wants to be spoken to, such as brief or step by step

reason_for_calling.description: Why the caller is calling, as they last put it
